name: cascade
notes: README.md:57 labels the miner role 'Miner (no GPU)'; README.md:171 has a per-role 'needs GPU' table. GPU sits on the trainer and validator side: chain.toml:88 pins expected_gpu = 'NVIDIA L40S' for byte-exact king/challenger re-derivation, and pyproject.toml gates torch==2.4.1 behind the optional 'train' extra from a fixed CUDA index. Miner in practice deploys to rented GPU pods (Lium/Targon, scripts/remote_hosts.example.toml) for the ~3h training budget, so real-world cost is GPU-bound even though the miner process itself is not.
